claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO processes images in real-time at 45 frames per second.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our base YOLO model processes images in real-time at 45 frames per second.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast YOLO processes 155 frames per second while achieving double the mAP of other real-time detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Fast YOLO, processes an astounding 155 frames per second while still achieving double the mAP of other real-time detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO makes more localization errors compared to state-of-the-art detection systems.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Compared to state-of-the-art detection systems, YOLO makes more localization errors

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO is less likely to predict false positives on background than Fast R-CNN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLO makes less than half the number of background errors compared to Fast R-CNN.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO outperforms DPM and R-CNN when generalizing from natural images to artwork domains.
claims.evidence_quote_short: It outperforms other detection methods, including DPM and R-CNN, when generalizing from natural images to other domains like artwork.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO struggles to precisely localize small objects.
claims.evidence_quote_short: While it can quickly identify objects in images it struggles to precisely localize some objects, especially small ones.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO frames object detection as a single regression problem from image pixels to bounding boxes and class probabilities.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We reframe object detection as a single regression problem, straight from image pixels to bounding box coordinates and class probabilities.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO's unified architecture enables end-to-end training and real-time speeds while maintaining high average precision.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The YOLO design enables end-to-end training and real-time speeds while maintaining high average precision.
